test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of money invested at a certain rate of simple interest per annum amounts to Rs. 24500 in eight years and to Rs. 32000 in thirteen years. Find the sum invested.
solution:
**Given:**

Amount of sum of money invested for 8 years = Rs. 24500 

Amount of sum of money invested for 13 years = Rs. 32000

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100 

Simple Interest = Amount - Principle

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Simple Interest for 8 years,

24500 - P = (P × R × 8)/100 ............(1)

Simple Interest for 13 years,

32000 - P = (P × R × 13)/100 ............(2)

Subtracting (1) from (2)

⇒ (24500 - P) - (32000 - P) = (P × R × 13)/100) - (P × R × 8)/100 

⇒ 7500 = [(P × R )/100] (13 - 8) 

⇒ 7500 = 5 × (P × R )/100 

⇒ 150000 = P × R ...........(3)

Substituting the value of (3) in equation (1)

⇒ 24500 - P = (P × R × 8)/100

⇒ 24500 - P = (150000 × 8)/100

⇒ 24500 - P = 1500 × 8

⇒ P = 24500 - 12000 = Rs. 12500

**∴The sum invested. is Rs. 12500**
